scripts.db:local: wrangler d1 migrations apply sourcemetric --local --env local
scripts.deploy:manual: pnpm build:web && pnpm db:migrate && wrangler deploy --env=""

DB.description: D1 database for package history, projects, notes, and collection jobs. Cloudflare creates and binds this database; deployment applies the SQL migrations automatically.

APP_ENV.description: Keep this set to production for hosted deployments. Local authentication bypass only belongs in local development.

DEMO_MODE.description: Keep false for your real instance. The synthetic demo is a separate local-only configuration.

ACCESS_TEAM_DOMAIN.description: Your Cloudflare Access team hostname, such as myteam.cloudflareaccess.com (without https://). Create your Access application and allow policy using the [setup guide](https://github.com/Kamyab7/SourceMetric/blob/master/docs/deployment.md).

ACCESS_AUD.description: Application Audience (AUD) from the Cloudflare Access self-hosted application protecting your SourceMetric hostname.

APP_ORIGIN.description: Exact HTTPS origin of your custom domain, such as https://metrics.example.com, without a trailing slash. Add the custom-domain route in Wrangler after deployment.

OAUTH_KV.description: KV namespace for OAuth clients, hashed credentials, encrypted grants, and short-lived consent transactions. Use a separate namespace for each deployment.
